name: Super Real Mahjong PVI
original_name: スーパーリアル麻雀 PVI
source: The protagonist incidentally helped an old man Kayama Toubei, who happened to be a mahjong master. Kayama insisted in giving the protagonist something in return as his gratitude, and the protagonist accidentally said "I want a bride!", so the story begins where the protagonist must accept mahjong challenges from Kayama's daughter and students as candidates for bride.
